market.title: Anthropic Revenue Boom Boosts AI Stocks | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 8/17/2026
market.summary: Bloomberg Intelligence's Global Head of Technology Research Mandeep Singh reacts to Anthropic's revenue report, and news Alphabet is seeking billions in its debut bond offering in Australia. Plus, Former Biden White House Economics Senior Director Peter Harrell discusses how the War with Iran is making the Trump Administration more hesitant to impose the full power of tariffs as energy costs stay high. Finally, Bloomberg Chief Wall Street Correspondent Sridhar Natarajan talks news that Mark Walter is exploring selling stake in Chelsea FC. (Source: Bloomberg)
